0022600114.text: The Knicks (0-2, 12th in the East) host the Orlando Magic (0-2, 14th in the East), with both teams on two-game losing streaks. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery) and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), while Anthony Black (ankle sprain) and Jonathan Isaac (knee) are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the Knicks won the most recent meeting 132-120 in Orlando on December 13, 2025, with no games yet in the 2026-27 season series.
